en.hubeali: H 14652 – Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdul Rahmaan Bin Al-Hajjaaj, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws having said:

‘When Ali<sup>asws</sup> became the ruler, he<sup>asws</sup> ascended the Pulpit. So he<sup>asws</sup> Praised Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and Extolled Him<sup>azwj</sup>, then said: ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I<sup>asws</sup> will not give you the sustenance from your spoils of war (Al-Fey) a single Dirham (more than what each of you deserve) so long as I have a palm tree left in Yasrab (Al-Medina). So be truthful to yourselves. Do you see what I<sup>asws</sup> have prevented from myself<sup>asws</sup> that I<sup>asws</sup> shall give it to you?’ So Aqeel stood up and said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! You will consider me to be equal to a black man of Al-Medina?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Sit down! Is there not one here besides you to speak? And there is no preference to you except by a precedent (being foremost in Al-Islam) or by piety’.
en.sarwar: 204. Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdul Rahmaan Bin Al-Hajjaaj, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) having said:

‘When Ali (a.s.) became the ruler, he (a.s.) ascended the Pulpit. So he (a.s.) Praised Allah (azwj) and Extolled Him (azwj), then said: ‘By Allah (azwj)! I (a.s.) will not give you the sustenance from your spoils of war (Al-Fey) a single Dirham (more than what each of you deserve) so long as I have a palm tree left in Yasrab (Al-Medina). So be truthful to yourselves. Do you see what I (a.s.) have prevented from myself (a.s.) that I (a.s.) shall give it to you?’ So Aqeel stood up and said to him (a.s.), ‘By Allah (azwj)! You will consider me to be equal to a black man of Al-Medina?’ So he (a.s.) said: ‘Sit down! Is there not one here besides you to speak? And there is no preference to you except by a precedent (being foremost in Al-Islam) or by piety’.
